name: String of Pearls
hook: Shriveled pearls? You might be watering it all wrong.

steps.title: Bright, indirect light
steps.tip: Hang it near an east window; a little gentle morning sun keeps the pearls plump.

steps.title: Water when pearls pucker
steps.tip: Water when the soil is dry and pearls look slightly wrinkled; mushy pearls mean too much.

steps.title: Shallow pot, gritty mix
steps.tip: Use a shallow terracotta pot with cactus mix plus extra perlite so roots never stay wet.

steps.title: Root stem cuttings
steps.tip: Press 10 cm cuttings into moist gritty mix, lightly covering the lower nodes; roots form there.

steps.title: Cooler winter rest
steps.tip: Keep it cooler and drier in winter; water only if the pearls start to shrivel.

outro: Bright light, a gritty mix, and water only when the pearls ask.
